requirements.text: Upon loading the 'Dad Jokes' webpage, the system must automatically initiate a fetch request to the 'https://icanhazdadjoke.com' API to retrieve a random dad joke. The joke must be displayed in the designated joke display area, which is identified by the data-testid attribute 'joke'.

The user must be able to click the 'Get Another Joke' button (data-testid='get-another-joke-button'). Upon clicking, the application must asynchronously fetch a new random dad joke and display it in the joke container (data-testid='joke').

The user must be able to click the 'Get Another Joke' button (data-testid='get-another-joke-button'). Upon clicking, the application must asynchronously fetch a new random dad joke and display it in the joke container (data-testid='joke'), replacing either the placeholder text '// Joke goes here' or the previously displayed joke.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Display a dad joke on page load
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Automatic Joke Fetching on Page Load
  The system must automatically fetch a random dad joke from the "https://icanhazdadjoke.com" API and display it in the joke display area when the page loads.


  Scenario: [Normal] Display a dad joke on page load
    Given the webpage "Dad Jokes" is loaded
    When the system fetches a joke from "https://icanhazdadjoke.com"
    Then the joke display area with data-testid "joke" should show a dad joke

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Fetch and display a new dad joke when the button is clicked
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Fetch and display a new random dad joke when the user clicks the "Get Another Joke" button
  The user must be able to click the "Get Another Joke" button to fetch a new random dad joke from the "https://icanhazdadjoke.com" API and display it on the page.


  Scenario: [Normal] Fetch and display a new dad joke when the button is clicked
    Given the webpage is loaded and the joke container with data-testid "joke" displays "// Joke goes here"
    And the "Get Another Joke" button with data-testid "get-another-joke-button" is visible
    When the user clicks the "Get Another Joke" button
    Then a new dad joke is fetched from the "https://icanhazdadjoke.com" API
    And the joke container with data-testid "joke" is updated to display the fetched joke

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User clicks the "Get Another Joke" button to fetch a new joke
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-003 - Fetch and Display New Joke
  The system must replace the current joke in the joke display area with a newly fetched joke when the user clicks the "Get Another Joke" button.


  Scenario: [Normal] User clicks the "Get Another Joke" button to fetch a new joke
    Given the webpage is loaded with the title "Dad Jokes"
    And the joke display area with data-testid "joke" contains a joke
    When the user clicks the "Get Another Joke" button with data-testid "get-another-joke-button"
    Then the joke display area with data-testid "joke" should be updated with a new joke

reference_cases.title: [Edge] User clicks the "Get Another Joke" button multiple times in quick succession
reference_cases.description:
Feature: REQ-003 - Fetch and Display New Joke
  The system must replace the current joke in the joke display area with a newly fetched joke when the user clicks the "Get Another Joke" button.


  Scenario: [Edge] User clicks the "Get Another Joke" button multiple times in quick succession
    Given the webpage is loaded with the title "Dad Jokes"
    And the joke display area with data-testid "joke" contains a joke
    When the user clicks the "Get Another Joke" button with data-testid "get-another-joke-button" rapidly multiple times
    Then the joke display area with data-testid "joke" should eventually display a new joke
    And the joke should be different from the initial joke
